# Key fix: diag-opp means flip both column side AND vertical half. For top markers diag = (not col side, bottom); for bottom markers diag = (not col side, top). This reproduces demo exactly and yields TL=1/TR=9/BT=9 for test.
def f(g):
    H=len(g); W=len(g[0])
    cells=[(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if g[i][j]==5]
    r0=min(i for i,_ in cells); r1=max(i for i,_ in cells)
    c0=min(j for _,j in cells); c1=max(j for _,j in cells)
    P={}
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            v=g[i][j]
            if v!=5 and v!=0: P[v]=(i,j)
    items=sorted(P.items())
    lc,pL=items[0]; rc,pR=items[-1]
    ml_c='L' if pL[1]<c0 else 'R'
    mr_c='L' if pR[1]<c0 else 'R'
    ml_v='T' if pL[0]<r0 else 'B'
    mr_v='T' if pR[0]<r0 else 'B'
    out=[row[:] for row in g]
    ibh=(r1-r0-1)//2; ijw=(c1-c0-1)//2
    for i in range(r0+1,r1):
        for j in range(c0+1,c1):
            rb=(i-r0-1)//ibh; cb=(j-c0-1)//ijw
            qs='L' if cb<(c1-c0-1)/2 else 'R'
            qr='T' if rb==0 else 'B'
            cand=[]
            if (qs==ml_c and qr==ml_v) or (qs!=ml_c and qr!=ml_v): cand.append(lc)
            if (qs==mr_c and qr==mr_v) or (qs!=mr_c and qr!=mr_v): cand.append(rc)
            out[i][j]=cand[0] if len(cand)==1 else cand[1] if len(cand)==2 else None
    return out
